snippet.title: Sonic.Exe The Destiny - "Reborn Update" Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Challenge Fate Once Again!
Gamejolt Page - https://gamejolt.com/games/destinyiscallingyou/370194
Created By - Lucsan2015 (hi)

This new update brings reworked content like cutscenes, dialogues, bosses and an entire ending!
Enter this realm and help Tails, Knuckles, Eggman and Metal Sonic to get through the crisis!

Songs Used: Lethal Blow, Dokkan Battle Ost And Dragon Ball Legends Ost
